title: Van jaar tot jaar 1965-1974/1965-1978
authors: Collaris, J.W.M., Instituut voor toegepaste sociologie, ITS * Nijmegen (primary investigator)
contributors: Stichting voor onderzoek van onderwijs, SVO * Den Haag
Ministerie van sociale zaken * Den Haag (research initiator)
Instituut voor toegepaste sociologie, ITS * Nijmegen (data collector)
descriptions: The purpose of this study is to determine the coherence between social setting, school career and occupational career School career and occupational career since primary school / types of schools / jobs / part-time courses / unemployment / attitude towards many aspects of school and job / evaluation of career / social setting / parents' level of education, jobs / grandparents / aspirations, attitude in relation with child's career / position other members of family and friends / tests / advice / help / military service. Background variables: basic characteristics/ residence/ household characteristics/ characteristics of parental family/household/ occupation/employment/ income/capital assets/ education/ social class/ religion
